name: Fenris Keep
summary: On Fenris Isle, isolated in the heart of Lordamere Lake, Fenris Keep now belongs to the Scourge. Thule Ravenclaw holds the stone fortress that once sheltered Lordaeron troops.

sections.title: The Scourge on Lordamere
sections.body: Thule Ravenclaw rules Fenris Keep and threatens the Forsaken in Silverpine Forest. From the fortress, he sends Rot Hide gnolls to attack anyone who sets foot on the isle. Fenris Isle lies only miles across the water from the Tirisfal border. So the Forsaken at the Sepulcher and Undercity send champions to break the keep's defenses and end the rogue necromancer's rule.

sections.title: A Fallen Bastion of Lordaeron
sections.body:
Before the Third War, Fenris Keep guarded Lordamere Lake for the Kingdom of Lordaeron. A sizable force of troops held the island fortress. When the Scourge swept across the land, the keep fell with the rest of the realm.

Thule Ravenclaw, a former Kirin Tor wizard who betrayed his order, seized the fortress. He joined the Scourge and used necromancy to subdue the island's gnolls, making them the ravenous Rot Hide pack. Now he is entrenched deep within the keep's stone halls.

faq.answer: Fenris Keep is an isolated stone fortress on Fenris Isle in Lordamere Lake. Once a military stronghold for the fallen kingdom of Lordaeron, it is now held by the undead Scourge.

faq.q: Who rules Fenris Keep right now?
faq.answer: Thule Ravenclaw rules Fenris Keep. The former Kirin Tor mage betrayed the living to serve the Scourge, and commands undead-tainted Rot Hide gnolls from within the fortress.

faq.q: Why are there gnolls inside Fenris Keep?
faq.answer: Thule Ravenclaw subdued the local gnolls with dark magic and disease, twisting them into Rot Hide gnolls. They guard the castle and surrounding island as his loyal shock troops.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken care about Fenris Keep?
faq.answer: Fenris Keep gives the Scourge a defensible base on Lordamere Lake. It threatens Forsaken movements through eastern Silverpine Forest and Tirisfal Glades, so Sylvanas's forces cannot leave a Scourge commander unchecked so close to their borders.

angles.text: For the Horde, and especially the Forsaken, Fenris Keep is a lingering Scourge stronghold. They must eradicate it to safeguard Silverpine Forest and Lordamere Lake's waterways.
As a mage, you can see Thule Ravenclaw's betrayal of the Kirin Tor's teachings. He turned Dalaran's arcane knowledge to the Scourge's dark arts.
